title: Crystal structure of the dodecanuclear coordination compounds [RE12(DMF)24(HCOO)8(OH)16]I3·4DMF (RE = Eu, Nd)

synthesis.procedure: Crystalline DMF solvates of EuI3 were dissolved in absolute DMF (dried over CaH2, doubly distilled under argon, stored over molecular sieves). The solutions were stored for 4 weeks in contact with room atmosphere; slow hydrolysis/decomposition of DMF afforded large cuboid crystals of the title compound. Targeted gram-scale syntheses using formic acid, ammonium formate, HCOOH diffusion, or UV irradiation were unsuccessful and gave Eu(HCOO)3. Hydrolysis at −20 °C gave microcrystalline powder over the same period.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: slow hydrolysis of DMF solutions in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: large clear cuboid single crystals formed from the mother liquor; selected and sealed in capillaries with dry paraffin oil

properties.summary: Paramagnetic Curie–Weiss behaviour for the Nd12 cluster; μeff per Nd3+ agrees with free-ion values. Low-T drop of susceptibility/μeff attributed to crystal-field effects rather than demonstrated SMM blocking.
